statement.zh: 萨卡拉第一王朝精英/大墓发掘正式见 Emery《第一王朝大墓》III（EES Memoir 47，1958）。
statement.en: At Saqqara, First Dynasty elite/great-tomb excavations are formally documented in Emery Great Tombs of the First Dynasty III (EES Memoir 47, 1958).
